title: land
description: Land at a position: landing_position, or a point geo feature named by geofeature_id. A request gives at most one of them. When Core accepts a Task that names a geo feature, it copies the place's position into landing_position and keeps geofeature_id to say which place it came from, so the Task keeps the place as it was when sent. A later edit reaches the Task only if the operator chooses to update it. Without either, the Asset lands where it is when the Task starts. The Asset climbs or descends to the transit altitude, or keeps its current altitude if none is given. It flies over the position and lands.
